official_payment_modes: Amypo Student ERP Portal Payment Gateway (https://erp.amypo.edu.in/fees)
NetBanking NEFT/RTGS to Official Amypo Canara Bank Virtual Account (verified via ERP)
Challan deposit at on-campus Canara Bank Branch, Amypo Campus
payment_rules.security_warning: CRITICAL: Amypo Institute NEVER accepts fee payments through personal Google Pay/PhonePe/Paytm numbers, UPI QR codes sent over WhatsApp, or external unsecured links. Any payment request not originating from erp.amypo.edu.in is unauthorized and fraudulent.

condonation_range.rules: Allowed strictly on valid medical grounds, official university sports representation, or NCC/NSS participation.
condonation_range.documentation: Original medical certificate stamped by Registered Medical Practitioner submitted within 7 working days of absence to Office of Dean (Academics).

detention_threshold.consequence: Strictly detained from appearing in end-semester examinations. The student must repeat the entire semester in the subsequent academic year.

attendance.tracking: Attendance is updated hourly via biometric RFID entry in classrooms and visible in real time on the Amypo Student ERP app.

rules.curfew_time: 08:30 PM sharp. Turnstiles require biometric verification.
rules.late_entry_protocol: Requires written approval from Chief Warden. Three unexcused late entries result in parental notice.
rules.ragging_policy: Zero Tolerance. Anti-ragging committee operates 24/7 hotline.
rules.prohibited_items: Electric heaters, induction stoves, iron boxes, alcohol, smoking, fireworks.

hall_entry_rules.reporting_time: 30 minutes prior to exam commencement. Hall doors close 10 minutes prior.
mandatory_documents: Official Amypo Student Photo ID Card (physical card)
Semester Exam Hall Ticket generated and printed from Amypo ERP
prohibited_devices: Programmable scientific calculators (only non-programmable fx-82/991 series permitted)
Loose paper, notebooks, or written material

examinations.malpractice_penalty: Immediate debarment from remaining examinations + reporting to University Malpractice Inquiry Committee.

internships.eligibility: Students from 5th semester onwards with minimum CGPA of 6.5 and no active backlogs.
approval_process: Submit company offer letter to Department Internship Coordinator.
Obtain verification and No Objection Certificate (NOC) signed by HOD and Dean (Industry Relations).
Log internship weekly report on Amypo Industry Relations Portal.

security_warning.official_rule: OFFICIAL AMYPO INTERNSHIPS NEVER REQUIRE ANY REGISTRATION FEE, TRAINING CHARGE, OR SECURITY DEPOSIT.
scam_indicators: Company demanding money for interview slot, laptop allocation, or security clearance.
Offer letter issued from generic Gmail/Yahoo address instead of corporate domain.
Unrealistic stipends (e.g. ₹60,000/month for 1st year students) without technical interview.
Communication conducted exclusively via Telegram or WhatsApp groups.
security_warning.reporting_contact: placement@amypo.edu.in or visit Placement Cell in Block B, Ground Floor.

placements.eligibility_criteria: 7th semester students with minimum CGPA 6.0 and zero standing arrears.
placements.recruitment_security_warning: All campus recruitment notifications are posted ONLY on the official Amypo Placement ERP and sent from @amypo.edu.in emails. No external agency is authorized to collect recruitment fees on behalf of Amypo recruiters.
